_about: v4 'How it's landing' — the owner's view of a Space, the questions people send, and the reader's way of sending one

door.title: How it’s landing

lede.act: One page is asking for you. The rest is landing.
lede.watch: Nothing urgent. A few pages are worth a look.
lede.calm: It's landing. Nothing needs you today.
lede.floor_one: {{count}} person has been reading. Patterns show once five people have been through a page.
lede.floor_other: {{count}} people have been reading. Patterns show once five people have been through a page.
lede.actPage: One page is asking for you: {{lesson}}, page {{page}}. The rest is landing.

door.ownOnly: Your own reading is never counted.

questions.title: Questions for you
questions.none: No one has sent a question yet. When someone does, it lands here first.
questions.everyoneHint: Shows on that page for every member

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.mapLede: Each cell is a page. The brighter it is, the more people needed help there; a labelled one opens that page.

confusion_hotspot.headline: A page where many ask for help
confusion_hotspot.summary: On page {{page}} of {{lesson}}, {{askers}} people opened Explain or asked, and {{foggy}}% said it was still foggy.
confusion_hotspot.why: Help-seeking this concentrated usually means a step is missing on the page itself, not in the people reading it.

silent_misleader.headline: A page that hides a trap
silent_misleader.summary: {{clicked}}% said page {{page}} had clicked, then {{missed}}% of them missed its checkpoint.
silent_misleader.why: The page reads as clear and tests as wrong. Something on it is plausible and incorrect at the same time.

skipped_slide.headline: A page that's being passed over
skipped_slide.summary: People stay a median of {{seconds}} s on page {{page}} of {{lesson}} before moving on.
skipped_slide.why: Either the page carries nothing new, or it looks like it doesn't. If it matters, it needs a reason to stop.

speed_bump.headline: A page people come back to, later
speed_bump.summary: {{backs}} people turned back to page {{page}} from the page right after it.
speed_bump.why: The next page needs something this one didn't make obvious. Naming it here saves the trip back.

overpacked.headline: A page that asks too much at once
overpacked.summary: Page {{page}} holds people {{ratio}}× longer than the rest of {{lesson}}, and many ask for help there.
overpacked.why: Long, uneven time plus help-seeking is the shape of two ideas on one page.

leaky_bucket.headline: A Lesson that feels heavy
leaky_bucket.summary: {{pct}}% of readers stopped right after page {{page}} of {{lesson}}.
leaky_bucket.why: A drop this sharp is a wall, not fatigue. The page before it is where to look.

confusion_block.headline: A stretch where the thread got lost
confusion_block.summary: Pages {{first}}–{{last}} of {{lesson}} ran foggy for most who read them.
confusion_block.why: One missing link early in a stretch makes every page after it harder.

quiz_misalignment.headline: A question that tests something else
quiz_misalignment.summary: Page {{page}} read easily, yet only {{pct}}% passed its practice first try.
quiz_misalignment.why: When the page is clear and the question is missed, the question is asking about something the page doesn't teach.

calibration_gap.headline: Sure, and still missed it
calibration_gap.summary: On page {{page}}, {{pct}}% who said it had clicked still missed the checkpoint.
calibration_gap.why: Confidence without accuracy is the hardest kind to spot from the front of a room. This is where it is.

healthy.headline: {{lesson}} is landing well
healthy.summary: Few asked for help, and most cleared its checkpoints first try.
healthy.why: Nothing to change. Worth knowing which Lesson to point at when you build the next one.

themes.title: What people asked on page {{page}}
themes.count_one: {{count}} person asked · shown as themes, never word for word
themes.count_other: {{count}} people asked · shown as themes, never word for word
themes.few: Themes appear once five different people have asked on a page.

grid.title: Clicked vs. missed on page {{page}}
grid.few: Not enough check-ins and checkpoints yet to compare.

reader.line: Still foggy? Send it to the Space.
reader.title: Send it to the Space
